maintenance_led.reason: Sells cannabis flower, edibles, vapes through own Zen Leaf and MÜV dispensaries and wholesale; consumable products, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying cannabis at dispensaries and wholesale customers; not government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Verano did grow through many acquisitions of licensed operators, but now mainly grows through its own cultivation, brands and dispensaries.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch cannabis brands and dispensaries; products are consumables with low switching costs.

notes: Serial acquirer is a judgment call because Verano's early growth relied heavily on acquisitions.
